title: DocumentWorkSpec v2 — authored intent (sole owner: stage author / planning agent)
description: Versioned successor to the N0-signed document-work-spec.schema.json, per the user-adjudicated special-case bucket design (2026-07-22, wave 1). The v1 file is signed and is never modified; this file supersedes it for newly authored WorkSpecs only — existing records stay valid against pinned v1. Delta over v1, and nothing else: (1) root schema_version const '2' — the instance names its own schema, and the loader keys on it explicitly with no cross-version fallback; (2) verification_mode 'review_only' additionally requires review_only_rationale (why no deterministic check is possible) and not_supported_when (the condition under which the obligation's disposition would be NOT_SUPPORTED — the authoring-time mutation question); deterministic modes forbid both fields. Presence is mechanical; truth is reviewable: a hollow sentence passes this schema and is challenged at FULL review. Everything else is byte-for-byte the v1 design (V3-D5, V3-D7).

schema_version.description: The instance names its own schema (special-case bucket adjudication point 6). v1 instances carry no version field; the loader routes on presence/value and never falls back across versions.

instruction_ref.description: The exact frozen raw instruction (plan §6 step 1).

instruction_units.description: Stable, locatable units of the raw instruction. Every normative unit maps to at least one obligation; context requires a rationale (V3-D7, N1-A3).

inputs.description: Exact ground-truth/source refs + revisions. Absent when the instruction itself is the only input — never an empty placeholder.

document_assurance_profiles.description: Exact leaf DocumentAssuranceProfile refs. Whole field absent when none (V3-D2: absence means no profile, never an empty placeholder; N1-A1).

instructionUnit.description: One locatable instruction unit. 'obligation' binds obligation_ids; 'context' requires an explicit non-normative rationale (V3-D7).

parameters.description: Concrete values for the profile's declared parameters — task-local data belongs to the WorkSpec, never the profile (V3-D2).

profileSelection.description: Exact leaf profile pin. A non-authoritative bundle may expand to leaf refs before authoring but cannot override them (V3-D2).

review_only_rationale.description: Why a deterministic check is not possible for this requirement. Required exactly when verification_mode is 'review_only' — the cheap path costs one honest sentence (witnessed at V3-N3 §4.1: the run's one real defect sat in a five-line-scriptable obligation declared review_only).

not_supported_when.description: The concrete condition under which this obligation's review disposition would be NOT_SUPPORTED — the mutation question at authoring time. An obligation whose author cannot answer it is an impression occupying a requirement's slot; the inability to answer surfaces here, before review.

obligation.description: One requirement traced back to instruction units. Deterministic modes bind exact local checks (invariant 8); review_only additionally states why no check is possible and what would refute it (wave 1, narrow scope per adjudication point 1); every obligation later receives exactly one fulfillment claim and one review disposition (invariant 2).
